parsed.rationale: The second participating record resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. Lifting the shared 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator.next' implementation into a common package would couple production DebugPanel code to demonstration semantics, which is the wrong direction. Even absent the sample-app concern, the two packages ('DebugPanel' and 'Wallpaper') are unrelated domain packages, and creating a shared dependency between them solely to deduplicate a single small async iterator method would introduce unjustified coupling.
